TABLE.NAME: local_omeroembed_annotations
TABLE.COMMENT: Student-drawn annotations on an embedded OMERO slide - private to the student who created them (see classes/privacy/provider.php)

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the embed belongs to - matches the identity proxy.php already checks

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student this annotation belongs to

FIELD.NAME: embedid
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-placement token minted by author.js's generateEmbed(), not derived from the OMERO image id - the same image can be embedded in multiple places with independent annotations

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Annotation shape - only 'point' is supported so far

FIELD.NAME: geometry
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON, in real OMERO image-pixel coordinates - e.g. point: {x,y}

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional short student-entered note shown when the annotation is clicked

TABLE.NAME: local_omeroembed_embed_tracking
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per embed placement that a teacher has configured viewport tracking (for the heatmap feature) on - see classes/tracking_repository.php. Stores no personal data itself (no userid) - the actual samples live in local_omeroembed_view_samples.

FIELD.NAME: embedid
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-placement token, same one local_omeroembed_annotations keys on

FIELD.NAME: trackinguntil
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp - samples only get recorded while enabled=1 AND time() is before this. Recomputed as time-of-save + gatherdays*86400 every time the teacher saves the tracking panel with tracking enabled.

FIELD.NAME: sourceurl
FIELD.COMMENT: config.baseProxyUrl at the time tracking was last saved (see author.js) - the same base proxy.php URL (courseid/subject path plus images/dataset/browsable params) the real embed's own iframe src is built from. Nothing else records which OMERO subject/image an embedid points to (annotate.js/track.js run inside an already-loaded iviewer and never needed to), so heatmap.php needs this to build its own iframe.

TABLE.NAME: local_omeroembed_view_samples
TABLE.COMMENT: Periodic viewport-position samples for the teacher heatmap feature - real personal data (see classes/privacy/provider.php). Only recorded while local_omeroembed_embed_tracking says tracking is enabled/not expired for that embedid, and never for a viewer with moodle/course:manageactivities (teachers/managers are excluded so their own browsing doesn't pollute the heatmap they're reading).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Whose viewport this sample is - the whole point of the heatmap, and why this table needs real privacy-API coverage

FIELD.NAME: x
FIELD.COMMENT: Image-pixel x of the viewport centre - same coordinate convention as annotations.geometry

FIELD.NAME: zoompercent
FIELD.COMMENT: 1/resolution*100, same formula author.js's readCurrentView() already uses

TABLE.NAME: local_omeroembed_heatmap_frames
TABLE.COMMENT: Periodic server-side snapshots of the aggregate heatmap for one embed placement, captured by classes/task/capture_heatmap_frames.php while tracking is active - assembled into a downloadable animated GIF by video.php. A derived aggregate image with no userid column and no way to attribute any region to a specific student, so (like local_omeroembed_embed_tracking) this needs no privacy-provider coverage of its own.

FIELD.NAME: framedata
FIELD.COMMENT: Base64-encoded raw single-frame GIF bytes (classes/heatmap_renderer.php's own output) - plain LONGTEXT rather than the File API, same reasoning settings.php's own comment gives for why 'subjects' is a plain textarea: a small, short-lived artifact that doesn't need that machinery.

TABLE.NAME: local_omeroembed_subjects
TABLE.COMMENT: Teacher-owned OMERO service-account connections - see classes/subject_repository.php. Replaces the old site-wide settings.php 'subjects' admin textarea: each teacher manages their own named entries and never sees another's. The {subject} path segment in every proxy.php/author.php URL is this table's own id (globally unique), not the name - name is a pure UI label, never itself resolved from a URL (see omero_session.php's own comment on why: names are only unique per-owner, not globally).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning teacher - rows are only ever read/edited/deleted with this checked against the current user, see subject_repository.php

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher's own label, e.g. 'oral_biology' - unique per-owner (see the userid-name index), not globally

FIELD.NAME: omeropassword
FIELD.COMMENT: Encrypted via core\encryption::encrypt() - never stored or displayed in plain text, unlike the old admin textarea it replaces
